title: Research: exact PR2298 §3 opcounts on mixed adjacent widths (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers open question 2 of [#2413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2413) (`pr2298-format-recovery-audit`): are PR2298 section 3's operation counts right — ≤ `⌊d/2⌋` exchanges per reversal, ≤ `2(d−1)` per tensor map, and one interchange + one bit move per one-extra-bit pair?

**Yes**, on every mixed adjacent bit-width pattern at `d≤8` with widths in `{3,4}` (**510** patterns):

| Invoice | Count |
|---|---|
| Reversal exchanges | exactly `⌊d/2⌋` |
| Tensor-map exchanges | exactly `2(d−1)` |
| One-extra-bit pair | 1 interchange + 1 bit move |
| Equal-width pair | 1 interchange + 0 bit moves |

Sharpness: every `d=8` pattern attains `4` reversal / `14` tensor exchanges; the all-long pattern is the zero-bit-move extremal. Physical spot-checks apply the low-level `(swap|move)` stream through the pinned `physical.move_address` oracle and recover reversed field coordinates. Non-adjacent width gaps (`|Δw|≥2`) are rejected. **No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`. Does not claim a BIT supplier, chunk-swap coefficients, or section-7 exposure exponent.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/pr2298-section3-opcounts/`
- Tip: `039afd99d1ae6754afc1527f9e3164c1b811e0e9`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — exhaustive mixed-width schedule ledger answering #2413 OQ2

Closest prior: PR2298 §3 prose; Colkitt nonadjacent audit; [#2413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2413) (S3b word algebra left counts open). Soft overlap semantic ≈0.30–0.50 vs shared elementary schedule encoding; the 510-row bound/invoice ledger is not already certified there.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/pr2298-section3-opcounts/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/pr2298-section3-opcounts/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/pr2298-section3-opcounts/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/pr2298-section3-opcounts/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr2298-section3-opcounts
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PR2298_SECTION3_OPCOUNTS patterns=510 max_d=8 rev_bound=floor(d/2) tensor_bound=2(d-1) one_extra_bit=1+1 sharp_d8_rev=4 sharp_d8_tensor=14 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_PR2298_SECTION3_OPCOUNTS patterns=510 max_d=8 rev_bound=floor(d/2) tensor_bound=2(d-1) no_new_kappa
PASS_PR2298_SECTION3_OPCOUNTS_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=5
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr2298-section3-opcounts outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions / limitations

1. Do the same closed-form exchange counts hold for non-adjacent width gaps larger than one bit?
2. Can the section 7 exposure exponent be re-derived from these exact counts without asymptotic O-notation?
3. Physical spot-checks cover reversal only (not every tensor expose/restore); counts are certified for all 510 patterns.
